name: oauth-device-flow-p3
prompt: how should I let a smart TV app without a browser sign the user in against our OAuth server

chunks.content: purge the CDN edge cache for an asset path immediately after a new build is published
switched the dashboard to a dark theme using CSS custom properties
added a 50-connection database pool with a health-check ping on checkout

decided to use the device authorization grant: the TV asks our server for a device code and a short user code, shows that code on screen, and the person types it into a phone browser to approve the login
while the TV waits, it polls the token endpoint with its device code at the interval the server returns and only receives an access token once the user has confirmed on their separate browser
the /healthz endpoint returns 200 once the database pool is ready
extracted all UI strings into a message catalog for translation
generate the monthly invoice as a PDF and email it to the billing contact
export request latency histograms to Prometheus on the /metrics endpoint
the marketing landing page shows a QR code that deep-links into the app store listing for the mobile app
the remote-control pairing screen makes the TV and the phone exchange a 6-digit code over the local network so the phone can act as a touch remote
wrap outbound webhook delivery in exponential backoff with full jitter
records are soft-deleted with a deleted_at column and filtered from default queries
the server hands back a verification URI plus the user code, and the app renders both so the viewer can open the link on any phone to authorize the headless television client
